name: Minamiuonuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiuonuma city emblem in orange, red and blue: an orange ear of rice above a red and blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiuonuma, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Minamiuonuma city emblem — an orange ear of rice above a red and blue swirl
